intro.title: Since 1852, under one roof
intro.body: Stari Mayr has welcomed guests in the old town of Kranj since 1852. Through the generations, the house has stayed what it always was — a place to sleep for travelers and townspeople alike, a space with its own history.

rooms_preview.title: Rooms above the old square
rooms_preview.lead: The house offers double, triple and quadruple rooms. Each has its own bathroom, quiet privacy and the warmth of an old house, where a day in the city is easy to leave behind.

cards.name: Double room
cards.description: Spacious rooms with a double bed or two separate beds, depending on the room. Each has its own bathroom.

cards.name: Triple room
cards.description: The only one of its kind in the house — three beds and a little more room to spread out.

cards.name: Quadruple room
cards.description: Our largest rooms, suitable for up to four people — enough space for a family or a group of friends. An extra bed can be arranged on request, where the room's capacity allows.

atrium.title: Behind the front door
atrium.body: The inner courtyard is a quiet corner of the house, separated from the street by a single passage. We serve breakfast there in summer, and during the day you can sit in a pleasant atmosphere and enjoy the quiet of the old town.
atrium.imageLabel: Courtyard of the Stari Mayr house

contact.title: Come stay with us
contact.body: Rooms are available year-round. Write or call — we're happy to tell you what's free.

hero.title: Offer
hero.lead: The building, the rooms, breakfast and the courtyard — what awaits you at Stari Mayr.

roof.title: Under one roof
roof.body: The building on Glavni trg has stood here since 1852, and has welcomed guests looking for a place to stay in the old town of Kranj the whole time. In its rooms, the quiet of an old house, the closeness of the square and the feeling of being part of the town's story all come together.

zajtrk.title: Breakfast
zajtrk.body: For guests staying overnight, we prepare breakfast every morning — a self-service spread and dishes made to order. If you need a gluten-free, vegetarian or other special version, let us know when you book and it will be ready for you.

atrij.title: Courtyard
atrij.body: The inner courtyard with its vaulted colonnade is a quiet corner behind the house, where the pace of the town gives way to stillness. We serve breakfast there in summer, and during the day you're welcome to sit in a pleasant setting, between the garden and the shared space for guests.

kranj.title: Kranj
kranj.body: The house stands on Glavni trg, a few steps from Prešernova hiša and grad Khislstein, so you can step straight from your room into the streets of old Kranj. The Kokra canyon is a five-minute walk away, the airport is eight kilometers off, and Bled and Ljubljana are each about thirty kilometers from us.

closing.title: Come stay with us
closing.body: To book a room, click the reservation button below; for other questions, write or call us.

hero.title: About
hero.lead: From opening its doors in 1852 to today — the story of the house on Glavni trg in Kranj.

section1.title: The beginnings
section1.body: Stari Mayr opened its doors in 1852, on the square where it still stands today. Kranj was then a town of craftsmen and merchants, and the house by the square was a natural stop for anyone arriving from elsewhere. A place to sleep, a quiet night, and a new day ahead.

section3.title: Through the generations
section3.body: The house has changed hands, and each generation left its mark — new windows, different furniture, renovated bathrooms. Over the years the fittings, the rooms and the small details have changed, but everything has stayed true to the same purpose: that a guest feels comfortable and at home with us.

section4.title: Today
section4.body: Today the house offers double, triple and quadruple rooms on the first and second floors. Each has its own bathroom, quiet privacy and the warmth of an old house, where a day in the city is easy to leave behind. Breakfast is served in the courtyard in summer, and you're welcome to stay with us for a night, a weekend, or longer.

about.quote: »The house remains. Only the stories of the people who sleep in it change.«

hero.title: Rooms
hero.lead: Quiet rooms in a house dating to 1852, a few steps from the pulse of old Kranj.

rooms.intro: Stari Mayr offers eight rooms on the first and second floors of a house dating to 1852. Each has its own bathroom, quiet privacy and the warmth of an old house, just steps from Glavni trg and everything the old town of Kranj has to offer.

types.name: Double room
types.description: Double rooms are spacious and quiet, with a double bed or two separate beds, depending on the room. Each has its own bathroom and enough room for a comfortable stay in the heart of old Kranj.

types.name: Triple room
types.description: The triple room is the only one of its kind in the house, with three beds and a little more floor space than the double rooms. It suits three friends, parents with a child, or guests who want a little extra room.

types.name: Quadruple room
types.description: The quadruple rooms are our largest, suitable for up to four people, with enough space for a family or a group of friends. An extra bed can be arranged where the room's capacity allows.

rooms.accessibilityNote: Rooms are on the first and second floors and reached by stairs. If you need step-free access, write to us — we'll advise you on what's possible.

These Terms & Conditions apply to direct reservations at Guesthouse Stari Mayr made through our official website and online booking system.
By completing a reservation, the guest confirms that they have read, understood and accepted these Terms & Conditions.

sections.heading: RESERVATIONS
body: A reservation is confirmed when the guest successfully completes the booking process and receives a booking confirmation at the provided email address.
The guest is responsible for ensuring that all information provided during the booking process is correct, including the number of adults and children and the ages of children.
Prices are stated in EUR and apply to the selected room, dates, number of guests and selected rate type.
Extra beds are available only upon prior confirmation by the property and are subject to availability and the characteristics of the selected room.

sections.heading: RATE TYPES AND CANCELLATION
body: Two rate types are available for direct reservations:
Standard Rate
The reservation may be cancelled free of charge up to 7 days before the scheduled arrival date.
If the reservation is cancelled less than 7 days before arrival or in the event of a no-show, the property reserves the right to charge the full value of the reservation.

Changes to the reservation are possible up to 7 days before arrival, subject to availability. Changes to dates, room type, number of guests or other elements of the reservation may result in a change in price.
Non-refundable Rate
The Non-refundable Rate is 10% lower than the Standard Rate.
Reservations made under this rate cannot be cancelled free of charge. In the event of cancellation or no-show, the full value of the reservation will be charged.
Changes to a Non-refundable reservation are only possible by prior agreement with the property and are not guaranteed.
The specific conditions applicable to the selected rate are also displayed during the booking process.

sections.heading: PAYMENT AND PAYMENT CARD
body: Guests provide a valid payment card through the secure Stripe payment system when making a reservation.
Payment card information is processed by Stripe. Guesthouse Stari Mayr and the HBook booking system do not have direct access to the guest's complete payment card details.

For Standard Rate reservations, the payment card is used to guarantee the reservation and may be subject to pre-authorisation. A pre-authorisation does not constitute final payment for the accommodation.
The accommodation is paid directly at Guesthouse Stari Mayr. Payment can be made in cash or by payment card.
In the event of a late cancellation or no-show, the applicable amount may be charged in accordance with the conditions of the selected reservation.

For Non-refundable reservations, payment or reservation guarantee will be processed according to the conditions displayed to the guest during the booking process and the technical capabilities of the payment system.
If a pre-authorisation or other required card verification is unsuccessful, the property may request another valid payment card or payment method.

sections.heading: TOURIST TAX
body: Tourist tax is not included in the online reservation payment and is calculated and paid separately at the property.
The applicable tourist tax is determined according to the actual number of guests, their ages, number of nights and applicable regulations.
Tourist tax is not charged for cancelled reservations or no-shows where the accommodation service was not actually provided.

sections.heading: ADDITIONAL SERVICES AND CHARGES
body: Guests may select additional services during the booking process where available.
The price of each additional service is displayed before the reservation is confirmed.
Services or additional items requested later or during the stay may be charged separately.
Pets are permitted with prior notice. A pet supplement of EUR 10 per night applies.

sections.heading: CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT
body: Check-in is available from 14:00.
Check-out must be completed by 11:00 on the day of departure.
Guests will receive access instructions and other important information regarding their stay before arrival.
Early check-in or late check-out is only possible by prior arrangement and is subject to availability.

sections.heading: SMOKING
body: All rooms at Guesthouse Stari Mayr are non-smoking.
Smoking inside guest rooms is prohibited. In the event of a violation, a charge of EUR 200 will apply to cover additional cleaning, odour removal and preparation of the room.

sections.heading: GUEST RESPONSIBILITY AND DAMAGE
body: Guests are required to use the room, equipment and common areas carefully and responsibly.
Guests are responsible for damage caused intentionally or through negligence by themselves or persons included in their reservation.
In the event of damage, the property reserves the right to request reimbursement of the resulting costs.

sections.heading: HOUSE RULES
body: Guests are required to respect the house rules and the peace, safety and comfort of other guests.
In the event of serious or repeated violations, the property reserves the right to terminate the guest's stay without refund of the unused portion of the reservation.

sections.heading: EARLY DEPARTURE
body: If a guest decides after arrival to end their stay before the departure date stated in the confirmed reservation, unused nights are generally non-refundable.
A different arrangement may be made only by individual agreement with the property.

sections.heading: CANCELLATION BY THE PROPERTY
body: In exceptional circumstances where accommodation cannot be provided due to force majeure, technical failure, safety reasons or other unforeseen circumstances, Guesthouse Stari Mayr will inform the guest as soon as reasonably possible.
If the property is unable to provide the confirmed accommodation, any amount already paid for the reservation will be refunded.

sections.heading: COMPLAINTS
body: Guests may submit complaints to:
stari-mayr@t-2.net
Each complaint will be considered individually according to the circumstances of the particular case, and we will endeavour to reach an amicable solution.
Where possible, guests are encouraged to inform us of any issue as soon as possible, preferably during their stay, so that we have an opportunity to resolve it.

sections.heading: PRIVACY AND PERSONAL DATA
body: Guests' personal data is processed for the purposes of managing reservations, communicating with guests, providing accommodation services, processing payments and complying with legal obligations.

More detailed information regarding the processing of personal data, legal bases, retention periods, recipients of personal data and individual rights is provided in our Privacy Policy available on our website.

This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect through the Guesthouse Stari Mayr website, why we collect it, how we use it and what rights you have regarding the processing of your personal data.
We process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection legislation, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: Personal data we collect
body: Depending on how you use our website, we may collect:

first and last name,
e-mail address,
telephone number,
information voluntarily provided through our contact form,
information required to make and manage a reservation,
dates of stay, number and composition of guests and selected accommodation,
information required for payment or reservation guarantee,
technical data such as IP address, device type, browser and website usage information.
We only collect the data necessary for each specific purpose of processing.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal bases for processing
body: We may process personal data for:

responding to enquiries and communicating with guests,
creating, confirming and managing reservations,
providing accommodation services,
processing or securing payments,
complying with legal obligations,
website analytics with the user's consent.
Depending on the purpose, processing may be based on performance of a contract, steps taken before entering into a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, consent or legitimate interests.

sections.heading: Contact form
body: When you submit a message through our contact form, the information is sent directly to our e-mail address.
The information is not stored in a separate website database.
We use it to respond to your enquiry and communicate with you regarding your request.

sections.heading: Booking system
body: We use the HBook booking system and related technical solutions to manage direct online reservations.
During the booking process we may process:

name and surname,
contact details,
country,
arrival and departure dates,
number and ages of guests,
selected room,
reservation and payment information,
special requests voluntarily provided by the guest.
These data are processed for the purpose of managing the reservation and providing accommodation services.

sections.heading: Stripe and payment card information
body: We use Stripe for payment card processing and/or reservation guarantees.
Payment card details are processed through Stripe. Mayr d.o.o. and Guesthouse Stari Mayr do not receive or store the guest's complete payment card details.
Stripe may process personal data in accordance with its own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Google Analytics
body: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our website and to improve its performance.
Google Analytics is activated only where the visitor has provided the required consent through the cookie settings.

sections.heading: Google Maps
body: The Contact page contains an embedded Google Maps map to display the location of Guesthouse Stari Mayr.
When Google Maps is displayed or used, certain technical information may be transmitted to Google.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: Our website may use:

strictly necessary cookies,
Google Analytics cookies where the user has consented,
cookies or similar technologies related to external services such as Google Maps.
When you first visit the website, you will be shown a cookie notice.
You may accept or reject non-essential cookies and may change your preferences later.

sections.heading: Recipients of personal data
body: Personal data may be processed by or disclosed to service providers where necessary, including:

booking system providers,
Stripe,
Google in connection with Google Analytics and Google Maps,
website hosting and technical service providers,
accounting and other professional service providers,
public authorities where required by law.
We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: International data transfers
body: Some service providers, including Google and Stripe, may process personal data outside the European Economic Area in certain circumstances.
Where applicable, such transfers are carried out using appropriate legal mechanisms and safeguards in accordance with the GDPR.

sections.heading: Data retention
body: We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected or for as long as required by applicable law.
Reservation and business records may be retained for longer periods where required by accounting, tax or other legal obligations.
Information from enquiries that do not result in a booking or other business relationship is retained only for as long as necessary to respond to and handle the enquiry.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Subject to the conditions provided by applicable law, you may have the right to:

access your personal data,
request correction of inaccurate data,
request deletion,
request restriction of processing,
object to processing,
request data portability,
withdraw your consent where processing is based on consent.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority.
In Slovenia, the competent supervisory authority is the Information Commissioner of the Republic of Slovenia.

sections.heading: Data security
body: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration or misuse.
However, no transmission of information over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.heading: Changes to this Privacy Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, particularly if the website, service providers or applicable legal requirements change.
The current version will always be available on our website.
